install: touch ~/.bashrc && sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --no-package-lock && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local" && (command -v tsx >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/tsx" ] || npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.local" --no-audit --no-fund tsx) && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc)
